entries.title: Track divergence across isolated chat sessions
entries.mitigation: Use GitHub coordination artifacts, canonical issues, stable IDs, handoff contracts and daily integrated digest.
entries.trigger: A material claim, term or result exists only in one chat or conflicts with another track.

entries.title: Provider spend before rankability and Right Data gaps are proven
entries.mitigation: Require provider-gap evidence from Track A and Rankability Gate assessment from Track B before commitment.
entries.trigger: Provider outreach or contract request without a measured gap and exit criterion.

entries.title: Portal hardcodes rankings or Featured content
entries.mitigation: V502 consumes published snapshot and registries; Portal never calculates readiness or selects Featured independently.
entries.trigger: Portal source contains fixed intelligence outcomes not supplied by a versioned snapshot.

entries.title: Prototype or uncleared editorial assets reach Production
entries.mitigation: Enforce Prototype → Editorial Approved → Rights Cleared → Production Ready lifecycle and asset registry.
entries.trigger: Portal release references an asset below Production Ready.

entries.title: Snapshot or methodology mismatch between tracks
entries.mitigation: Validate common identifiers and fail closed at G1/G2/G4.
entries.trigger: snapshot_id, methodology_version or evidence_lineage_version differs across artifact chain.
